description: Effective OIDC settings (the client secret is never returned)

enabled.description: Whether OIDC sign-in is on. It also needs the issuer URL, client ID, client secret and redirect domain

issuer_url.description: The https address of the OIDC provider (its issuer); empty when not set

client_id.description: The client ID registered for NPMpro at the provider

client_secret_set.description: Whether a client secret is saved or set by the environment. The secret itself is never returned

redirect_domain.description: The domain this instance is reached on, with its port when it is not 443; the callback address is built from it

scopes.description: Space separated scopes asked from the provider; it always includes openid. Default: openid email profile

require_verified_email.description: Whether the provider must report the email address as verified. Default: on

skip_mfa.description: Whether a user who signed in with OIDC skips NPMpro's own second factor. Default: off

disable_password.description: Whether password sign-in is refused so that only OIDC works. Default: off

enabled.description: Whether an account is created on the first OIDC sign-in of an unknown email address. Default: off

allowed_domains.description: Email domains that may get an account; empty allows any domain

permissions.description: The permissions a created account gets, in the shape of a user's permissions

auto_create.description: What happens when someone signs in with OIDC and has no account yet

label.description: Text of the button, 1 to 40 characters. Default: OIDC

color.description: Background colour of the button as #rrggbb. Default: #206bc4

type.description: builtin for an icon of the list, file for an uploaded or downloaded image
builtin for an icon of the list, file for an uploaded or downloaded image

ext.description: File type of the saved image

updated_on.description: When the image was saved, as a Unix time in milliseconds

icon.description: The icon on the button: one of the built-in icons, or an image that was uploaded or downloaded

button.description: How the OIDC button on the sign-in page looks

locked.description: Fields set by environment variables (read only)

locked_by.description: The environment variable that sets each locked field (name only, never the value)

active.description: Whether OIDC sign-in works with the effective settings

secret_error.description: Whether the saved client secret cannot be decrypted and must be entered again

callback_url.description: The redirect address to register at the provider; empty until the redirect domain is set

session_auth_method.description: How the session that made this request signed in: oidc or password. A request made with an API token reads password
